name: square modulo a secret composite and emit a low bit each step
mechanism: start from a seed coprime to a product of two secret primes; repeatedly replace the state by its square modulo that product, emitting the lowest bit (or a few) each time; predicting the next bit is as hard as factoring the modulus

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Blum Blum Shub' in section Combinatorial algorithms / General combinatorial algorithms:

fails_when: one modular squaring per bit -- very slow
